# The Roaring Forty | 1983-2023

The Roaring Forty is a comprehensive retrospective box set spanning Billy Bragg's four-decade career from 1983 to 2023. The collection exists in multiple configurations, with the definitive 14-CD Super Deluxe edition containing 324 tracks across just over 18 hours of material. This expansive set includes all twelve of Bragg's studio albums in full, alongside highlights from collaborations, non-album singles, B-sides, session recordings, rare live performances, and previously unreleased material. The package is accompanied by a 12-inch book featuring 40 significant objects from Bragg's career with accompanying descriptions and reminiscences from the artist himself.

The box set functions as both a musical and biographical document, tracing Bragg's evolution as a politically engaged folk-rock artist. It captures his trajectory from his early protest songs—such as "Island Of No Return" from Brewing Up With... (1984), which addressed the Falkland Islands conflict—through his more commercially accessible period, including standout tracks like "North Sea Bubble" from Don't Try This At Home (1991). The retrospective demonstrates an artist who has consistently engaged with social and political themes while maintaining artistic development across multiple decades.

Critical reception positioned the collection as a definitive career overview. The box set was designed to appeal to both longtime followers and those seeking a comprehensive introduction to Bragg's work, with the curated selections handpicked by the artist himself. The accompanying book and extensive liner notes elevate it beyond a simple compilation, presenting it as a narrative of artistic growth and personal reflection.
